title: The Machine Village
learning_focus: Examples, uses, advantages, and limitations of inclined planes, wedges, levers, and pulleys.
story_premise: Village workers struggle to move supplies because the tool stations are broken or used for the wrong task.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Examples, uses, advantages, and limitations of inclined planes, wedges, levers, and pulleys.

areas.title: Inclined Plane Road
areas.story: Compare force and distance tradeoffs. Use a wedge model for splitting or separating.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: The station in Inclined Plane Road is not working correctly.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe carefully, investigate Examples, uses, advantages, and limitations of inclined planes, wedges, levers, and pulleys, record the evidence, and use it to restore the station.
